featured_reviews.name: Sarbjeet Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Refreshing Classic in Matunga!
Naturals Ice Cream in Matunga East is a true gem for lovers of fruit-based, natural ice creams. From the iconic Tender Coconut to seasonal delights like Sitaphal and Mango, the flavors burst with authenticity thanks to their minimal ingredient list—just fresh fruit, milk, and sugar.

What sets this outlet apart is its consistent quality, innovative Friday specials, and wide variety—including gems like Coffee Walnut and Roasted Almond. The ambiance is no-frills but clean, making it a perfect grab-and-go spot, especially for students from nearby Khalsa College.

Pros:
• Pure, natural flavors
• Seasonal & innovative varieties
• Quick service
• Reasonable pricing
• Great location in Matunga East

Cons:
• Limited seating
• Parking can be tricky during peak hours

Final Word:
If you're in Mumbai and craving something fresh, fruity, and fuss-free—Naturals at Matunga is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys real fruit ice creams without any artificial gimmicks!

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Albal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let me start straight — the attitude at this place is ruining what could otherwise be a great shop.
I’ve been visiting since childhood. Back when the father used to sit at the counter, there was warmth, humility, and genuine respect for customers. That’s how this place built its reputation.
Now? Completely different story.
The son who currently handles the counter is shockingly rude, ill-mannered, and arrogant. The way he speaks to customers feels dismissive and disrespectful — like he’s doing you a favor by serving you. Ask about flavors and you’ll either get a half-hearted answer or visible irritation. He doesn’t properly explain the menu and often seems like he doesn’t even know it well himself.
Let’s be clear — the ice cream still tastes great. I’ve always loved the flavors, and quality-wise, it’s still solid.
But customer service matters. A business doesn’t survive on taste alone. If the person representing the shop lacks basic courtesy and communication skills, loyal customers will eventually stop coming.
It’s disappointing to see a place with so much history slowly being dragged down by poor behavior at the counter.
Fix the attitude, or the shop’s future doesn’t look very bright.

featured_reviews.name: Aatmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been visiting this soft serve ice cream shop for years, and it’s always a great experience. They offer a wide variety of ice cream at affordable prices, including vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry soft serve, basket ice cream, and ice slushies.

The soft serve is consistently delicious, and they usually have seating available, which is a nice bonus. The machines are almost always working too, so you can count on them being ready to serve.

Some of my favorite treats include the chocolate chip soft serve, chocolate/Strawberry soft serve, vanilla with chocolate syrup, 2-flavoured soft serve, the chocolate ice cream and the chocolate brownie sundae. Everything I’ve tried here has been fantastic!

A heads-up: they only accept cash—no cards—so make sure you’re prepared.

Also the place is not usually crowded and even if it is crowded the shop parlour is spacious and can stand and slurp the desert. The service is very quick. They got alot of flavours. The quantity and quality of the softy is worth. I ordered their merry mango which is served in waffle basket and topped with alphanso mango pieces and whipped cream. The softy tasted really natural and it did tasted yummy. The pieces were also very sweet. If you love softy ice cream you must atleast here once. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Hamzah Malgi
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Apsara Ice Creams, Matunga this Makar Sankranti—and it was a delightful experience! A legendary brand serving real fruit ice creams since 1971, the cozy ambiance adds to the charm. Loved their festive flavours—Crunchy Chikki Ice Cream was pure nostalgia, and Strawberry Slice was fresh and fruity. The Pani Puri Patakha Ice Cream was surprisingly fun and truly unique! Chocolate lovers must try the Belgium Bite, and their Zero Added Sugar options are perfectly balanced. With 50+ flavours, creamy shakes, and ingredients like full cream buffalo milk and real fruits, this place is a must-visit for ice cream lovers. 🍨🪁

featured_reviews.name: Rupali mom Blogger
featured_reviews.review_text: Me and my son tried Apsara Ice Cream and we both loved it. The flavours taste fresh and natural, and the quality is really good. My son enjoyed it a lot, and I liked that it wasn’t overly sweet. The place was clean and service was nice too. Definitely a good spot for family ice cream outings. Would love to visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Anish Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ice cream are our all-time favourite rite? Tht too with some super innovative flavours which you never tried. Apsara ice creams, one of the oldest brands of Mumbai has some of the best flavours for you. Been to this place with my family and honestly four of us had our own choice available in this brand. Believe me its very rare.
Outlet is done very nice and they are not as small as other ice cream places. Green colour looks wow in their interiors. They got, sorbets, kulfies and ice creams with many flavours in fruit, nuts and chocolate based. You can taste taste their ice creams which will help you to choose the best one. We tried 4 flavours like motichoor laddu icecream (Special for ganapati festival), sugar free kesar pista, coffee and paan.
Motichur laddu flavour was super hit, spcial for ganapati festival had good amount of bundi in it and balanced taste of saffron and sweetness was just perfect. Must order and would request them to keep this flavour 36 days in their menu.
Paan flavour is again was one of the best. Enjoyed it.
Next time I will try their shakes and even the pani puri sorbet which I coudnt try. Yes don’t miss their guava on which they sprinkle spicy seasoning. From now onwards I would order from apsara on regular bases for sure. Thanks to the team for such a warm experience.

featured_reviews.name: Mihir Bhanushali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thankyou Apsara Ice Cream for a good experience.
Had their Brownie Blast Ice-Cream and Cookies n Cream. Both the ice-creams were good in taste.
Their ambience is nice and they also have board games, so you can have a good time at Apsara Ice Creams❤️
Overall - Nice

featured_reviews.name: Roshni Thought Process Lab
featured_reviews.review_text:
I really love Apsara's Premium Gift Pack. It says personalised in the best way possible. The premium gift pack contains 4 assorted ice creams boxes, that one can choose as per their liking. I chose four flavours:

1. Belgian Bite
2. Guava Glory
3. Diwali Delight
4. Roasted Almonde

If you ever want to give a personalized gift this is the one! It is easy to order from their website.

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Badekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Apsara has become one of my favorite ice cream parlour. It serves you different flavours of ice creams. Also, they introduce new flavours "recent new is chikoo". I visit here very offend and always end up trying different flavours. It is a small place with decent ambiance and they also have games on the upper floor. Pocket friendly. They have got outlets all over Mumbai. Head out to there near by outlet and try there ice creams. Tried their strawberry with cream, rose, blueberry, ferrero rocher, Belgium chocolate ice cream.  Other flavours I have tried is guava, cookie n cream, falooda, chikoo. This are also must try!

featured_reviews.name: Kkomal Maru
featured_reviews.review_text:
Apsara in Matunga is located at Matunga Circle, making it easily reachable for people.

As such small outlet but has mezzanine floor to sit as well. Has some board games to play as well.

We had spicy Guava, bubblegum, orange & coffee ice cream. I personally loved spicy guava & coffee flavor ice creams. Both are irresistible.

featured_reviews.name: Kailash Maheshwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good variety of icecreams, unhygienic environment,flys are everywhere,there is a instruction written for workers,NET ON BEARD.
But who cares the signage,it's there to simply ignore.
Once name is built up,Apsara icecreams have now taken it for granted come what may, customers will come & go.

featured_reviews.name: Ananya Bhowmick
featured_reviews.review_text:
I tasted a Cocheta’s cake for the first time at a friends place and fell in love! I’ve been ordering from Cocheta’s for the past year, for every birthday and anniversary, on popular demand from family members!
The cakes are fresh, moist, and tastefully decorated, with just the correct amount of sweetness! They are lovingly made and are just divine 😊
Complete value for money and I have ordered from them at short notice too!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I've ordered fro Cocheta twice.They are very good

The next time I ordered a vanilla lemon cake. It had a strong flavour,  a good kick of lemon....just as I like it. On my request, Deepti changed the icing colour to a pretty shade of blue.

Deepti is very easy to talk to and is rather accommodating as well. I've had a good experience with Cocheta 😊

featured_reviews.review_text: It was a pleasant suprise. My family absolutely loved the Roasted Almond Caramel cake. We never had it before and Deepti is the only one who makes such unusual cakes with vibrant designs and a twist to the flavourful palate.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We walked in looking for falooda of all things, and they surprisingly had this on the menu.

My mum chose a falooda which was technically unavailable. We were intent on picking out something else, when Ganesh (I asked his name only because of this reason) said he could make the falooda for us, if we wanted. And he did!

(I don't want to write too many details, because it will 1) sound insane; 2) may attract problem customers for the chap.

Honestly, Ganesh was polite in the beginning, but this above-and-beyond service took me by surprise.

The ice cream was nice; nothing very different from similar shops in the area. But this kind of service will keep us coming back every time.

(There is a service-theme to my reviews.)

featured_reviews.name: Chitrang Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most pathetic counters of Havmor ice-cream. We ordered two large scoops of ice-cream and since the measure seemed small than what was mentioned (230ml) on their display board, we asked them to measure it for us.

They had a weighing machine that measured in grams. Neither did it convert grams to ml nor were the storekeepers aware about it. When the store manager, Mr. Vishnu Shinde, was called - he categorically denied saying what has been measured by the storekeeper is what will be served.

I intend to put in a complaint in the consumer forum on this as there needs to be widespread awareness of such rampant malpractices. I have attached the requisite photographs as well. Any assistance towards this would be appreciated.
